# Elevares Studio — Complete AI & Search Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Elevares Studio is a Calgary, Alberta spatial documentation and real estate media studio specializing in pre-drywall 360° construction scans, RECA-compliant RMS measurements, calibrated iGUIDE 360° virtual tours, 2D/3D dimensioned floor plans, virtual staging, and HDR real estate photography with a guaranteed 24-hour standard turnaround.

## Canonical Service Pages (https://www.elevares.ca/services)
1. **Real Estate Photography Calgary** (https://www.elevares.ca/services/real-estate-photography-calgary)
   - Bracketed HDR interior and exterior photography, true-to-life window views, wide-angle architectural framing, optional twilight/dusk exteriors, MLS®-ready web and high-resolution print files, and bundled package savings in 24 hours.
2. **RMS Measurement Services Calgary** (https://www.elevares.ca/services/rms-measurement-calgary)
   - Strictly follows Alberta RECA Residential Measurement Standard (RMS):
     - Detached homes, duplexes, and townhomes measured around exterior foundation wall (including exterior wall thickness).
     - Apartment-style condominiums with shared demising walls measured strictly interior paint-to-paint.
     - Below-grade levels—including finished walkout basements, bi-level lower floors, and split-level lower floors—excluded from above-grade RMS totals and reported separately.
     - Minimum floor-to-ceiling height of 2.13 m (7 ft); sloped/vaulted ceiling zones included down to 1.52 m (5 ft) if the room reaches 2.13 m elsewhere.
     - Strictly maintained within RECA's 2% variance tolerance using calibrated iGUIDE infrared lidar and exterior verification.
     - Excludes attached/detached garages, open-to-below voids, decks, balconies, and unheated sunrooms from above-grade RMS.
3. **360° Virtual Tours & Pre-Drywall Construction Scans Calgary** (https://www.elevares.ca/services/360-virtual-tours-calgary)
   - Interactive iGUIDE 360° walkthroughs with synchronized floor plan minimaps for Calgary MLS® listings.
   - Pre-drywall 360° construction scans for custom homebuilders and multi-family developers capturing exposed framing, electrical runs, plumbing rough-ins, and HVAC before insulation/drywall closure.
   - Live flagship case study: Multi-Family Pre-Drywall Construction Scan — 4510 51st Ave, Olds, AB (https://youriguide.com/4510_51st_ave_olds_ab).
4. **Real Estate Floor Plans Calgary** (https://www.elevares.ca/services/real-estate-floor-plans-calgary)
   - Branded and MLS®-ready 2D and 3D floor plans with room-by-room imperial and metric dimensions, clear above-grade vs. below-grade breakdowns, and offline print-ready PDF, PNG, and JPG exports.
5. **Virtual Staging Calgary** (https://www.elevares.ca/services/virtual-staging-calgary)
   - Photorealistic furniture placement for vacant new builds, Calgary infills, and dated rooms in Modern, Contemporary, Transitional, Warm Minimalist, and Scandinavian styles, adhering to transparent CREB MLS® disclosure best practices with paired original and staged images.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **When should builders schedule a pre-drywall 360° construction scan?** Right after framing, electrical runs, plumbing rough-ins, and HVAC ductwork pass inspection—immediately before insulation and drywall boarding begin.
- **How does a pre-drywall scan protect builders during warranty claims?** It gives site supervisors a permanent browser-accessible 3D digital twin showing pipe paths, shutoff valves, backing, and electrical lines behind finished drywall, avoiding exploratory tear-outs.
- **Can homeowners use the 360° scan after possession?** Yes—builders share the interactive iGUIDE link in the possession package as a digital "X-ray" blueprint for mounting TVs, cabinetry, shelving, or planning basement developments safely.
- **Do you scan multi-family developments and builds outside Calgary?** Yes—Elevares Studio serves Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks, Chestermere, and Central Alberta communities including Olds (4510 51st Ave multi-family project).
- **Are your RMS measurements compliant with RECA standards in Alberta?** Yes—every measurement adheres to RECA's exterior vs. paint-to-paint rules, below-grade/walkout exclusion, 2.13 m (7 ft) ceiling rule, and 2% accuracy tolerance.
- **How fast is turnaround?** Standard 24-hour turnaround from the on-site visit for pre-drywall scans, RECA RMS reports, 2D/3D floor plans, virtual staging, and HDR real estate photography.
- **Can I bundle RMS, floor plans, 360° tours, and photography in one visit?** Yes—one technician captures the full media package in a single appointment to save coordination time and reduce per-listing cost.
- **How should a job site or listing be prepared?** Clear loose tarps/drywall stacks from framing walkways on construction sites; for finished listings, turn on interior lights, open window blinds, and clear countertops and floors.
